modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.core
modules.description: Guard checks, singletons, timers and disposables shared by every Pretzel module.

modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.extensions
modules.description: Extension methods for .NET and Unity types (string, IO, GameObject, Transform, collections and more).

modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.data
modules.description: Save and load with keys, save slots, recoverable writes, migrations, auto-save and a pluggable serializer. Includes the Data Format window and the SerializableGuid drawer.

modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.tween
modules.description: Easing functions for float, Vector2, Vector3 and Color.

modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.ui
modules.description: UI Toolkit helpers: element factories, fades, screen navigation, safe area, toasts, world-space helpers, a screen controller base and Editor UI building blocks.

modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.ui.ugui
modules.description: UGUI components: UIFader, hover fade and Button and Graphic extensions.

modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.api
modules.description: An Awaitable HTTP client on UnityWebRequest with retries, timeouts, progress and cancellation.

modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.events
modules.description: A typed in-memory event bus and ScriptableObject event channels with listener components.

modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.di
modules.description: A small reflection-based dependency injection container with singleton, scoped and transient lifetimes, [Inject] members, child scopes, entry points and a LifetimeScope component.

modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.pooling
modules.description: Prefab pools on UnityEngine.Pool with prewarming, IPoolable reset hooks, self-releasing PooledObject and a per-prefab PoolRegistry.

modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.scenes
modules.description: An Awaitable scene loader with additive loading, activation gating, progress, minimum duration, cancellation and fade transitions.

modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.audio
modules.description: An audio manager with pooled AudioSources, AudioCue assets, per-channel volume through an AudioMixer or directly, and crossfading music.

modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.preferences
modules.description: Player preferences for audio, graphics, controls and language, saved through Pretzel Data, with change events and graphics apply.

modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.devconsole
modules.description: An in-game UI Toolkit log overlay and command console for development builds, with a thread-safe log buffer and a command registry.

modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.templates
modules.description: Script templates for Pretzel types (MonoBehaviour, UI controller, singleton) and a UI Toolkit theme template.

modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.integrations
modules.description: Optional adapters between Pretzel and LitMotion, UniTask and R3. Each adapter assembly compiles only when its library is installed.

modules.name: com.uee03.pretzel.editor
modules.description: Standalone editor utilities that work in any project and need no other Pretzel module.
